about.body: The AJ200D is Jaguar Land Rover's 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine from the Ingenium family, in production since 2015. It's fitted across Jaguar's modern range in the E-Pace, F-Pace and XE, with power outputs ranging from 150 to 200 hp depending on variant and whether single or twin-turbo configuration is fitted. The engine is also used across Land Rover's range in various applications.

byModel.body: Across the XE, the AJ200D has powered the D150, D180 and D200 variants (X760, 2015–present). The F-Pace carries it in D165, D180 and D200 form (X761, 2016–present). The E-Pace uses it across the D150, D165, D180 and D200 variants (X540, 2017–present). We work on all three applications regularly, with single and twin-turbo configurations accounted for once your exact model and year are confirmed.

compatibility.body: Registration/VIN matching is required — early vs late production variants differ (improvements were made from 2019 onwards). Single vs twin-turbo variants also differ significantly in ancillary configuration. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
